resume_protocol: Fetch latest main SHA and verify whether main moved from the recorded base.
Fetch PR metadata, exact head SHA, changed files/diff, CI status, and this checkpoint before editing.
Treat only committed code with passing tests as completed; never infer completion from chat history.
If main moved, compare and reconcile explicitly; never force-reset or overwrite unverified work.
Keep all v0.4.1 functional changes on this branch until release gate passes.
Never reintroduce subtree:true broad MutationObserver patterns or documentElement-wide observers.
After each completed stage, update this checkpoint with commit SHA and CI evidence when available.
product_principle: 少卡片、轻色差、强层级、连续阅读；不问用户是谁，优先问用户想分享什么。

S0.name: Recovery contract and baseline
requirements: Create draft PR early and keep this checkpoint authoritative.
Verify main=79d958c3f832e6685cad299b3b2cee4f4e418621 and no open PRs at start.
Preserve v0.4.0 API/KV/share-token contracts and exam-entry performance baseline.

S1.name: Remove audience false-choice
requirements: Remove 家人/老师/自定义 as a primary sharing decision.
Normal flow becomes 分享什么 -> 查看将分享内容 -> 生成并复制链接.
自定义 becomes 修改分享内容 advanced disclosure rather than a peer persona option.
No teacher preset that merely toggles existing checkboxes.

S2.name: Default share contract
requirements: Single exam defaults to nickname, exam name/date, overall score/rank, six-subject scores/ranks.
Trajectory defaults to the same plus exam history, overall-position changes and subject changes.
School/class remain hidden by default unless explicitly selected under 修改分享内容.
Natural-language summary states 将分享 and 不会分享; notes/account/member/security data remain impossible to share.

S3.name: Card density reduction
requirements: Only current coordinate keeps Hero Surface visual weight.
Recent change becomes medium Section Surface.
Sources, six subjects and history become compact rows/timeline items rather than full cards.
Historical exams must not visually compete with current/latest exam.

S4.name: Restrained semantic color
requirements: Current coordinate uses very light brand green.
Recent change uses very light cool blue-gray.
Concrete data uses white/warm-neutral surfaces; history uses gray-white.
Attention uses very light amber only for 值得留意, never as bad/fail semantics.
No red=bad or green=good academic judgment.

S5.name: Timeline state semantics
requirements: Visually distinguish historical exam, currently viewed exam, and latest exam.
Latest exam uses light brand-green state.
Viewing an older exam uses neutral surface plus brand outline, never masquerading as latest.
PC click/hover and Android horizontal-scroll/click behavior remain equivalent.

S6.name: Card size and responsive density
requirements: Hero Surface may remain prominent; Section Surface uses roughly 12-16px padding and 12-14px radius.
Row/item content avoids full-card chrome when separators and spacing are sufficient.
At 360-430px use roughly 12-14px ordinary horizontal padding, around 8px gaps, and six-subject rows around 48-56px.
Historical timeline nodes must not approach full-screen card width.
No page-level horizontal scroll; main tap targets >=44px.

S7.name: Persona cleanup audit
requirements: Audit existing 学生/家长 reading perspective for the same persona-overdesign problem.
If it only changes copy without changing data/task architecture, consolidate to one universally readable trajectory.
Identity modes are allowed only when permissions, data contract or reading architecture materially differ.

S8.name: Weak-network, privacy and regression
requirements: Do not change v0.4.0 API/KV/share-token contracts.
Single-exam shares stay permanently pinned; trajectory shares retain overview/subject/six-subject/touch timeline.
No continuous DOM mutation or exam-entry performance regression.
Weak network must not create blocking old-UI to new-UI morphing.
PC/Pad/Android/keyboard focus/touch/scroll regressions covered.

release_gate: S0-S8 marked completed with repository evidence.
Version exactly 0.4.1 across package.json, package-lock.json and wrangler.toml.
npm run verify passes on the final PR exact head.

UI contract tests prove there is no 家人/老师 persona split, default share summary is correct, semantic color and compact-density contracts exist, timeline has three states, 360px/touch rules hold, observer guard and privacy hold.
Final self-review finds no duplicate legacy audience UI and no oversized-card regression in share reading.
PR marked ready only after final-head CI success.
Merge with expected_head_sha; then main CI must pass.
Cloudflare deploy must checkout the exact tested main SHA.
Production /api/health must attest appVersion=0.4.1 before declaring completion.
